title: A summarizing memory forgets the summary it built once the room has not been read for its summary_cache_ttl_seconds: with no time left to it, the next read starts from its window, and the summarizer is asked again with no prior summary
notes: As memory/a-summary-is-carried-into-the-next-read, with summary_cache_ttl_ms 0: a summary outlives no read. At the fourth question the history passes the second threshold and Question 1 to Answer 2 are summarized (Summary 1). At the fifth, where that scenario carries Summary 1 and calls no summarizer, the summary is forgotten: the read starts from its window, Question 1 to Answer 4, and summarizes Question 1 to Answer 3 again (Summary 2), reading no prior summary, Question 4 and Answer 4 kept. Python: memory/_summary_chain.py SummaryChains.get (now - used_at >= ttl), memory/summarizing.py _summary (its cache under the same time).
